title: Introduce onboarding-manifest schema and staged publish pipeline for first-time models
creator: Ava Chen
description: Create a machine-readable onboarding manifest schema and an automated staged publish pipeline (dev -> canary -> stable) that gates model catalog publishing on metadata validation and performance-signature checks. The pipeline must produce pinned version updates and an automated rollback mapping if a perf regression is detected during canary evaluations. Also update model catalog docs and onboarding checklist to reflect the new manifest and publish flow.
background: Current onboarding is manual: engineers add model entries to the catalog UI and publish performance profiles by hand. This leads to inconsistent metadata, missed provenance fields, and occasional regressions after new quant/variant publishes. We need a canonical manifest format + CI-gated publish path to reduce human error and speed onboarding while preserving safe rollouts.
tradeoffs: We introduce higher initial engineering complexity to implement the schema, CI gates, and evaluation harness. This will slow down the fastest path for trusted partners in the short term but yields safer, more predictable publishes. We will ship an opt-out flag for internal early access teams for the first two weeks if needed. There is some duplication risk with existing model-index YAMLs; plan includes a migration script to convert legacy entries to the new manifest.
implementation_steps: 1) Define onboarding-manifest v1 schema (fields: canonical_model_id, source_uri, version_tag, variant_id, tokenizer_spec, supported_sequences, quantization_profile, provenance, baseline_perf_signature_id, recommended_batching, safety_notes). 2) Add JSON Schema and lint rules in catalog repo. 3) Implement CI step that validates manifest and runs smoke evals against baseline. 4) Build publish workflow: push -> dev publish (internal) -> canary publish (limited traffic & eval suite) -> stable publish (pin as latest). 5) Implement automatic rollback mapping: if canary perf delta > threshold, revert pin to previous version and create incident ticket. 6) Docs: update onboarding checklist, manifest reference, and runbook for manual rollback. 7) Create migration tool to translate legacy entries. 8) QA: smoke test with two community models and one internal variant. 9) Ship and monitor for 2 weeks, collect metrics for failures and false positives.
acceptance_criteria:
- A JSON Schema for onboarding-manifest v1 exists and is enforced by CI.
- A PR that adds linting and schema validation merged (link included).
- The publish pipeline can promote a test model through dev -> canary -> stable automatically.
- Canary evaluation runs and compares perf signature to baseline; if regression > 3% latency or > 2% quality drop on eval set, pipeline marks canary as failed and triggers rollback.
- At least two new models have been onboarded using the manifest and their catalog entries were created by the automated pipeline.
- Catalog docs updated with example manifests and an onboarding checklist; docs reviewed by PM and Docs owner.
- Monitoring dashboards show model publish success/failure counts and average time-to-stable.
